title: Megalovania is older than Undertale
caption: Megalovania was written years before Undertale, for an EarthBound ROM hack. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #undertale #megalovania

instagram.caption:
Megalovania, the song you hear in the Sans fight, was not written for Undertale.

A teenage Toby Fox made it for an EarthBound ROM hack, then it showed up in the webcomic Homestuck.

In 2015 he gave it to Sans, and it became one of the most remixed boss themes in history. It even made it into Smash Bros.

How many tries did Sans take you?
